mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM > 1% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -0.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals strong demand across both housing and consumer sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 1% and RSAFS MoM > 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing YoY, the combined effect signals a high-interest rate environment with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
